contents: Anny's compact 104-bone skeleton (MakeHuman/MPFB2 default 163-bone rig pruned of tongue, breast, facial-expression and zero-weight bones, with removed bones' weights merged onto their nearest retained ancestor) and hand-painted linear blend skinning weights over the 13,380 body vertices of MakeHuman hm08 (up to 8 influences per vertex, normalised to sum to 1).
